note: Sora UI moved: ui.soralabs.io.vn 301s to ui.soralabs.studio, whose sitemap (fetched with tools/sitemaps.mjs --only=ui.soralabs.studio, 103 urls) lists one page per component. /catalog/<name> are the older catalogue components (cursor-trail-reveal, infinite-scrolling-images, scroll-chapters, scroll-gallery, sticky-scroll-cards, text-reveal-box, tilt-slide-transition), /motion/<name> the motion components (accordion, cursor-bubble, dia-text-reveal, …), /ui/radix/<name> the primitive set (accordion, alert-dialog, …, files path registry/primitives/…). Unmatched: demo-*, the four icons-* items (the animated icons share one /icons gallery page) and border-trail. /motion and /ui/base soft-404 (200 + generic title) — the pages that exist were verified individually (accordion, magnetic-cards, text-reveal-box, catalog/cursor-trail-reveal …).
